```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  message = FALSE
)
```

Let's make a plot for length and width of sepal in iris data!

```{r iris}
library(plotly)

plot <- plot_ly(
  iris,
  x = ~Sepal.Length,
  y = ~Sepal.Width,
  type = "scatter",
  mode = "markers"
)

plot
```
